notifications-static-x86_64-full-os-v2.purpose: Fresh Linux follow-up of the genuine pinned cosmic-notifications build after the 1200-second attempt reached its deadline without a linked ELF. Only the per-command deadline is extended to 3600 seconds; jobs, disk growth and image bounds are unchanged. Growth remains an experimental bound, not measured successful peak. Full-OS 64 MiB image including 2 MiB stack; unchanged builder retains its legacy 16 MiB LOAD inspector. Runtime needs real session bus, Wayland layer surfaces and software rendering; panel/applications, accessibility and notification lifecycle require separate validation.
